desc: Derive the prime-wise reformulation: for each prime \(p\), adjacent exponents satisfy \(\lvert e_i-e_{i+1}\rvert=v_p(A_i)\), while the global gcd condition is equivalent to \(\min_i e_i=0\) for every prime.
Establish the exponent-height bound: every normalized path with minimum zero has all heights at most \(H=\sum_i v_p(A_i)\).
Implement the complete Python solution using the per-prime bounded height DP with a “visited zero” flag, and verify against all three public samples.
Ensure zero-difference transitions are counted exactly once, factorization collects all relevant primes, and all score weights are computed modulo \(998244353\).
